head: codex/5823-v0-92-wp-06-remote-validation-build-runner
title: [v0.92][WP-06] Harden remote validation runners
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5823

## Summary
- harden AWS launch cancellation, cleanup, paid-work ceilings, and fail-closed fallback classification
- harden Nessus cancellation, timeout handling, redacted log publication, and named-container cleanup
- require exact validation revision and reject undeclared dirty source paths
- remove cross-suite fixture collisions so focused AWS and Nessus checks can run concurrently

## Validation
- AWS portable adapter tests: 26/26
- portable remote-validation contract tests: 10/10
- focused AWS and Nessus shell suites: PASS individually and concurrently
- platform-matrix validator and self-test: PASS
- cargo fmt check, shell syntax, and git diff hygiene: PASS

## Review
- bounded exact-head subagent review: APPROVE, no findings

## Boundaries
- Windows proof remains fixture-qualified rather than live-native
- no second paid AWS run was needed for deterministic adapter hardening
